title: Radiometric transfer — Planck inversion to brightness temperature

assertions.derivation: KNOWN_ANSWER_MATRIX radiometric family: T=K2/ln(K1/L+1) round-trips the scene T=300+2*sin(2*pi*col/128). Over full periods the sine sums to zero (mean exactly 300 K) and the population sigma of A*sin is A/sqrt(2)=sqrt(2)=1.41421356. Float32 storage perturbs the mean by <1e-4. Catches Celsius submissions (mean 26.85) and DN-path inversions.
Scene extrema are 298 K and 302 K; 0.1 K slack covers Float32 rounding only.
All scene inputs are valid; a correct product has (nearly) no NoData pixels.
